children.text: 如何在 SVG 中绘制文本。
标签可以在 SVG 中绘制文字

content.code:
<svg width="150" height="50" viewBox="0 0 150 50">
  <text x="20" y="30">You are a dog.</text>
</svg>

content.html:
<svg width="150" height="50" viewBox="0 0 150 50">
  <text x="20" y="30" fill="gray">You are a dog.</text>
</svg>

content.code:
<svg width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200">
  <path
  d="M 20 10 L 20 120 M 10 30 L 120 30 M 10 70 L 120 70 M 10 110 L 120 110"
  stroke="gray"/>
  <text x="20" y="30">You are a dog.</text>
  <text x="20" y="70">You are a pig.</text>
  <text x="20" y="110">You are a cat.</text>
</svg>

content.html:
<svg width="200" height="140" viewBox="0 0 200 140">
  <path
  d="M 20 10 L 20 120 M 10 30 L 120 30 M 10 70 L 120 70 M 10 110 L 120 110"
  stroke="gray"/>
  <text fill="gray" x="20" y="30">You are a dog.</text>
  <text fill="gray" x="20" y="70">You are a pig.</text>
  <text fill="gray" x="20" y="110">You are a cat.</text>
</svg>

children.text: 来指定文本的水平对齐方式，有三种取值

content.code:
<svg width="250" height="200" viewBox="0 0 250 200">
  <path d="M 120 10 L 120 120" stroke="gray" />
  <text x="120" y="30" text-anchor="start">You are a dog.</text>
  <text x="120" y="70" text-anchor="middle">You are a pig.</text>
  <text x="120" y="110" text-anchor="end">You are a cat.</text>
</svg>

content.html:
<svg width="250" height="140" viewBox="0 0 250 140">
  <path d="M 120 10 L 120 120" stroke="#1a66ff" />
  <text fill="gray" x="120" y="30" text-anchor="start">You are a dog.</text>
  <text fill="gray" x="120" y="70" text-anchor="middle">You are a pig.</text>
  <text fill="gray" x="120" y="110" text-anchor="end">You are a cat.</text>
</svg>

children.text: 我们可以通过字体属性修改文字，包括

content.code:
<svg width="600" height="200" viewBox="0 0 600 200">
  <text
    x="20"
    y="30"
    font-weight="bold"
    font-family="Times New Roman"
    font-size="30"
    font-style="italic"
  >
    You are a dog.
  </text>

  <text x="20" y="70" text-decoration="underline">You are a pig.</text>
  <text x="220" y="70" text-decoration="line-through">You are a pig.</text>
  <text x="420" y="70" text-decoration="overline">You are a pig.</text>

  <text x="20" y="110" word-spacing="5">You are a cat.</text>
  <text x="220" y="110" letter-spacing="4">You are a cat.</text>
</svg>

content.html:
<svg width="600" height="120" viewBox="0 0 600 120" fill="gray">
  <text
    x="20"
    y="30"
    font-weight="bold"
    font-family="Times New Roman"
    font-size="30"
    font-style="italic"
  >
    You are a dog.
  </text>

  <text x="20" y="70" text-decoration="underline">You are a pig.</text>
  <text x="220" y="70" text-decoration="line-through">You are a pig.</text>
  <text x="420" y="70" text-decoration="overline">You are a pig.</text>

  <text x="20" y="110" word-spacing="5">You are a cat.</text>
  <text x="220" y="110" letter-spacing="4">You are a cat.</text>
</svg>

children.text: 有时候我们需要对一段文字某些文字添加独立的文本修饰，比如下划线，删除线等，所以我们会考虑使用多个
但是有一个问题就是我们不知道文本的长度，如果使用多个
标签，那么文本摆放的位置就成了一个问题，这个时候我们可以在

content.code:
<svg width="150" height="40" viewBox="0 0 150 40">
  <text x="0" y="20">
    Hello
    <tspan font-family="Times" font-weight="bold" text-decoration="underline">
      World!
    </tspan>
  </text>
</svg>

content.html:
<svg width="150" height="40" viewBox="0 0 150 40" fill="gray">
  <text x="0" y="20">
    Hello
    <tspan font-family="Times" font-weight="bold" text-decoration="underline">
      World!
    </tspan>
  </text>
</svg>

children.text: 除了可以修改文本属性之外，还可以通过
修改被包含的字母的垂直位置偏移，并持续生效，
是一个数组，其中的数与每个字母一一对应，如果数组中数目少于字母数，默认为

content.code:
<svg width="150" height="40" viewBox="0 0 150 40">
  <text x="0" y="20"><tspan dy="0 6 6">C6H12O6</tspan></text>
</svg>

content.html:
<svg width="150" height="40" viewBox="0 0 150 40" fill="gray">
  <text x="0" y="20"><tspan dy="0 6 6">C6H12O6</tspan></text>
</svg>

children.text: 个字母，不足会自动补零，相当于
是会叠加的，会持续影响后面的字母，要使得后面的字母正常显示，需要在后面指定一个相反值使得

content.code:
<svg width="150" height="40" viewBox="0 0 150 40">
  <text x="0" y="20"><tspan dy="0 6 -6 6 0 -6 6">C6H12O6</tspan></text>
</svg>

content.html:
<svg width="150" height="40" viewBox="0 0 150 40" fill="gray">
  <text x="0" y="20"><tspan dy="0 6 -6 6 0 -6 6">C6H12O6</tspan></text>
</svg>

children.text: 它可以控制字母的水平偏移，同样它也是持续生效的，会影响到后面的字母；也可以通过
来控制字母的旋转，同样影响是持续的

content.code:
<svg width="150" height="40" viewBox="0 0 150 40">
  <text x="0" y="20">
    Hello
    <tspan dx="0 4 -2 6 0 2" rotate="10 -20 20 0 20 -10">World!</tspan>
  </text>
</svg>

content.html:
<svg width="150" height="40" viewBox="0 0 150 40" fill="gray">
  <text x="0" y="20">
    Hello
    <tspan dx="0 4 -2 6 0 2" rotate="10 -20 20 0 20 -10">World!</tspan>
  </text>
</svg>

children.text: 会更加的简单，它有两种取值：

content.code:
<svg width="150" height="60" viewBox="0 0 150 60">
  <text x="0" y="20">
    C
    <tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">6</tspan>
    H
    <tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">12</tspan>
    O
    <tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">6</tspan>
  </text>
  <text x="0" y="50">
    6.02×10
    <tspan baseline-shift="super" font-size="10">23</tspan>
  </text>
</svg>

content.html:
<svg width="150" height="60" viewBox="0 0 150 60" fill="gray">
  <text x="0" y="20">
    C
    <tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">6</tspan>
    H
    <tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">12</tspan>
    O
    <tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="10">6</tspan>
  </text>
  <text x="0" y="50">
    6.02×10
    <tspan baseline-shift="super" font-size="10">23</tspan>
  </text>
</svg>

children.text: 来设置文本的长度，SVG 会通过调整字符间距或文本大小以使得文本达到规定的大小。调整方式有两种，通过
：同时调整字符间距和字符大小

content.code:
<svg width="150" height="100" viewBox="0 0 150 100">
  <text x="20" y="20" textLength="120">Hello World!</text>
  <text x="20" y="40" textLength="120" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">
    Hello World!
  </text>
  <text x="20" y="60" textLength="80">Hello World!</text>
  <text x="20" y="80" textLength="80" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">
    Hello World!
  </text>
</svg>

content.html:
<svg width="150" height="100" viewBox="0 0 150 100" fill="gray">
  <text x="20" y="20" textLength="120">Hello World!</text>
  <text x="20" y="40" textLength="120" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">
    Hello World!
  </text>
  <text x="20" y="60" textLength="80">Hello World!</text>
  <text x="20" y="80" textLength="80" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">
    Hello World!
  </text>
</svg>

content.code:
<svg width="150" height="150" viewBox="0 0 150 150">
  <text x="20" y="20" writing-mode="tb">Hello World!</text>
</svg>

content.html:
<svg width="150" height="100" viewBox="0 0 150 100" fill="gray">
  <text x="20" y="20" writing-mode="tb">Hello World!</text>
</svg>

children.text: 文本除了可以横向和纵向排列以外，还可以沿着某一路径进行排列

content.code:
<svg width="250" height="150" viewBox="0 0 250 150">
  <defs>
    <path 
  id="curve"
  d="M30 40 C 50 10, 70 10, 120 40 S 150 0, 200 40"
  style="stroke: gray; fill: none;">
    </path>
  </defs>
  <text>
    <textPath xlink:href="#curve">
      Hello, World!
    </textPath>
  </text>
</svg>

content.html:
<svg width="250" height="60" viewBox="0 0 250 60" fill="gray">
  <defs>
    <path 
  id="curve"
  d="M30 40 C 50 10, 70 10, 120 40 S 150 0, 200 40"
  style="stroke: gray; fill: none;">
    </path>
  </defs>
  <text>
    <textPath xlink:href="#curve">
      Hello, World!
    </textPath>
  </text>
</svg>
